title: Iceland Font
description: No this pack doesn't add Iceland, Iceland is just the font's name.
body:
Hey there I'm back!

This pack adds the font: **Iceland**! You can find it [here](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Iceland?preview.script=Latn&categoryFilters=Feeling:%2FExpressive%2FCalm;Technology:!%2FTechnology%2F*)!

My friends told me that I should make another pack and uh it worked out pretty well, I made them pick the font for me as I don't have any personal ideas, but it sure was fun discussing about it with them in voice chat!

Have fun with this font!
